Uilleann chanter in 3D

How to use this view

Drag to turn; right-drag, shift-drag or move two fingers to slide the view; scroll or pinch to zoom in on whatever is under the pointer; double-click a part to turn round it, and Reset view to go back. Draw Explode to pull the strips outward and the plates apart along the chanter. Every part is the cut file’s own outline. The strips, darker, taper with the cone: wider toward the sole. The lid, three layers, carries the seven finger holes; the back, two layers, the thumb’s. At the top, the tenon and the wider collar, then the socket the strips stand in; at the sole, the foot.
